facts.value: Study and research in the heart of Europe! As an international university with an excellent reputation, Goethe University offers a wide range of programs.
The Global Office supports international exchange and scholarship students during their studies at Goethe University – from preparation to personal support on site in Frankfurt.
The Goethe Welcome Centre has compiled important information and services for international postdoctoral researchers, doctoral candidates, and professors at Goethe University.
From initial consultation to the buddy program: Goethe University offers services regarding applications, scholarships, residency rights, and much more for a successful start in Frankfurt.
Need support for your career start? The International Career Service Rhein-Main helps you successfully transition from study to work in the German job market.

Goethe University supports refugees before, during, and after their studies. The offerings include preparatory courses and language courses, scholarships, assistance with finding housing, administrative procedures, financing, and integration.
Discover language offerings and opportunities for preparatory studies for foreign applicants at Goethe University.
